solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Admit first of hordes into imposing municipal building

indicators.note: into says the admitted letters go inside the word for imposing

parts.note: an imposing figure is tall
to admit something is to own it, as in owning up

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of hordes

explanation.surface: A grand civic building lets in the leading member of a crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: The civic hall where a council meets is the classic municipal building.

clue.text: Queen boarding railway vehicle for country

indicators.note: boarding means getting on, so the queen's letters go inside the vehicle

parts.note: a train runs on a railway
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the usual Queen abbreviation

explanation.surface: A monarch gets on a train heading out to the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Country in the sense of land or ground of a certain kind, as in hilly country.

clue.text: Golf-club with sharpness

parts.note: an edge is sharpness, as in a voice with an edge

explanation.surface: A golf club described as having a keen edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A lofted iron used for short pitches and bunker shots is a type of golf club.

clue.text: Charge on, sir, wildly riding in contest

indicators.note: wildly says the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: A cry to a rider to charge on, galloping wildly in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Jockeys riding competitively against each other is the sport of the turf.

clue.text: Likely experimental area blocked by one French article

indicators.note: blocked by means the lab has the numeral stuck in its middle

parts.note: a lab is where experiments happen
I is the Roman numeral for one
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: A laboratory is probably obstructed by a single French item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one French article' looks like a single phrase, but 'one' is I and 'French article' is LE.
explanation.definitionFit: Liable to do something means apt or probable to do it, a synonym of likely.

clue.text: Highlander's second bed

definitions.note: read as Highlander is, the 's being the link

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A Highland man's spare bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Scottish Highlands is a Scotsman.

clue.text: Font appropriate for message?

definitions.meaning: a typeface, the monospaced typewriter-style one
a person who carries messages, as a font name would fittingly be

explanation.surface: Choosing a typeface that suits a message.
explanation.walkthrough: The query flags that the second sense is a playful one: the messenger's name suits a message.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a monospaced typeface and a delivery messenger.

clue.text: What identifies book, and part of effect it left?

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A question about what names a book and some lingering effect.
explanation.definitionFit: A book is known by its name printed on the cover and spine.

clue.text: Equestrian clause added to document

definitions.meaning: an extra provision attached to a bill or contract

explanation.definitionFit: Both a person on horseback and an amendment tacked onto a legal text.

clue.text: Relation providing financial statement

definitions.meaning: a narrative or report, as in the telling of a story
a record of money in and out, as from a bank

explanation.surface: A relative supplying a set of figures.
explanation.definitionFit: A relation is a narrated report, and a bank statement is the other sense.

clue.text: One supports wicked things

parts.note: wicked here means having a wick, not evil: the holder props up waxy things with wicks

explanation.surface: Someone backs evil deeds.
explanation.definitionFit: A holder for wax tapers, each with a wick, is what this clue describes cryptically.

clue.text: Beer head avoided by healthy

indicators.note: head avoided means the first letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: hale means healthy, as in hale and hearty

explanation.surface: A fit person stays off the beer froth.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional brewed drink, a synonym of beer.

clue.text: Plant, inelegant, straggling

indicators.note: straggling means growing untidily, so the letters spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A plant that looks ungainly as it spreads.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweetbriar, a wild rose, is a flowering plant.

clue.text: Close to swallowing first and last of claret — a lovely drink

indicators.note: swallowing means the word for close takes the picked letters inside it

parts.note: near means close

indicators.note: first and last of picks the outside letters of claret

explanation.surface: Nearly gulping down some claret, a delightful drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Close' is an adjective here, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The drink of the gods in myth, now any delicious beverage.

clue.text: Church getting least wrecked keyboard instrument

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: wrecked means ruined, so these letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: A church has its least valuable keyboard ruined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' turns the letters of least into ESTA.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument with a keyboard striking metal plates, heard in the Sugar Plum Fairy.

clue.text: US state not entirely colourful

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter is left off the state

parts.note: the Sunshine State in the southeast

explanation.surface: An American state that is only partly vivid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' drops the A from FLORIDA.
explanation.definitionFit: Florid means ruddy or highly ornate, a synonym of colourful.

clue.text: Merit of French tennis stroke

parts.note: de is French for of
the serve opens each point in tennis

explanation.surface: Assessing the merit of a French player's serve.
explanation.definitionFit: To merit something is to be worthy of it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Artist upset, very upset with a feature of naval scene?

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician
mad means furious

explanation.surface: A painter is upset with a feature of his sea painting.
explanation.definitionFit: A great fleet of warships, like the Spanish one of 1588, fills a sea battle picture.

clue.text: Game? Poet's written about harmful one

indicators.note: written about means the poets' word goes round the other letters

parts.note: bard's, a bard being a poet
ill means harmful, as in ill effects
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A poem about a dangerous game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poet's' is read as the plural poets, not a possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue sport played on a cloth table with pockets is one game.

clue.text: Setback around end of course — inferior

indicators.note: around means the setback word wraps the picked letter

parts.note: a blow is a setback

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of course

explanation.surface: A setback near the finish, leaving one below par.
explanation.definitionFit: Below means lower in rank or quality, a synonym of inferior.

clue.text: Firm succeeded in producing lettuce

parts.note: CO is company, a firm
S is the genealogy abbreviation for succeeded

explanation.surface: A company has done well growing salad.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-leaved romaine variety is a type of lettuce.

clue.text: Curtain's opening on start of play, revealing desert plants

indicators.note: opening means just the initial letter of curtain is used

parts.note: Act I is the opening of a play

explanation.surface: The curtain rises on a play, showing a desert stage set.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiny succulents of arid regions are the archetypal desert plants.

clue.text: Gal, as an alternative, bringing Italian dish

indicators.note: alternative means another version, so these letters take a different order

explanation.surface: A girl offers an Italian dish as another option.
explanation.definitionFit: Layered pasta sheets with sauce, a famous dish from Italy.

clue.text: Suffer popular treatment mostly

parts.note: in means popular, as in the in crowd

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a cure is a treatment

explanation.surface: Undergo a fashionable remedy, almost entirely.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a loss or cost is to suffer or bring it upon oneself.

clue.text: Question development of thaw?

indicators.note: development of means the letters evolve into a new order

explanation.surface: Wondering about how the thaw will progress.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the basic interrogative word, standing for a question itself.

clue.text: Show no progress when results are delivered?

definitions.meaning: to stand still, as soldiers marching on the spot
read literally, the moment scores or grades are handed out

explanation.surface: Stalling while waiting for exam results.
explanation.walkthrough: The query marks the literal reading: the moment marks are given out.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for marching on the spot means making no headway; literally it is the hour of grading.
